cut: The Brink 3, DRAFT v1 (23 Oct) — one question: who can make the GPS jamming stop?
argument: Finnish aviation sees GPS interference around the clock. Finland and the Baltics took it to the ITU, whose board urged Russia to stop, again, then strongly. No reply is on record.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Who can make the / GPS jamming [stop]?
text.ja: GPS妨害を [止められる] のは / 誰？

text.en: In Finland, aviation sees / GPS interference / [around the clock].
text.ja: フィンランドの 航空では / GPS妨害が [24時間] / 続いている。

captions.source: Traficom, 21 Apr 2026: GNSS interference concentrated in aviation, around the clock, in southern and central Finland; observations up clearly since February. Traficom statistics (8 May 2026): daily since January 2024, originating outside Finland. Re-checked 23 Oct (plan/films/22-again-urged.md).

text.en: Finland and the Baltic states / complained to the UN's / radio body, the [ITU].
text.fi: Suomi ja Baltian maat / valittivat YK:n alaiselle / radioelimelle, [ITU:lle].
text.ja: フィンランドと バルト三国は / 国連の 無線機関、 / [ITU] に 訴えた。

captions.source: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: co-signed submission to the Radio Regulations Board, 98th meeting; Finland: joint statement at the ITU Council (June 2025) and the board's decision naming receivers in Estonia, Finland, Latvia and Lithuania (ITU 'Harmful interference to RNSS'); Traficom's interference reports.

text.en: Its board [urged] Russia / to stop. Then again urged. / Then strongly urged.
text.fi: Lautakunta [kehotti] Venäjää / lopettamaan. Sitten uudelleen. / Sitten painokkaasti.
text.ja: その 委員会は ロシアに 停止を / [求めた]。 さらに 再び 求め、 / 強く 求めた。

captions.source: ITU Radio Regulations Board: repeated instructions to urge the Administration of the Russian Federation to stop the interference; 100th meeting (Nov 2025) again urged it to immediately cease interference to receivers in Estonia, Finland, Latvia and Lithuania (Inside GNSS; ITU Council document); 2026, 101st and 102nd meetings: strongly urged (ITU 'Harmful interference to RNSS'). Minutes not opened; paraphrased, never quoted.

text.en: Urged. Again. Strongly. / Reply on record: [none].
text.fi: Kehotettu. Uudelleen. / Painokkaasti. / Vastauksia kirjattu: [ei yhtään].
text.ja: 求めた。 再び。 強く。 / 記録された 返答は [なし]。

captions.source: ITU 'Harmful interference to RNSS': at the 102nd meeting the bureau reported no reply from Russia to the interference reports (Lithuania); 101st: Latvia had received no response. No Russian reply to the board found (23 Oct). 'On record' because that is what the records show.

airspace.ja: 南フィンランド 上空

map.en: the moving-map screen: coast, sea and lakes, no place names
map.why: the screen shows only shapes; the corner tag says where

flag.why: the small flag by the icon after it jumps: what a crew would ask, not a claim

postmarks.why: country codes on the four envelopes: Finland and the three Baltic states, no flags

tray.why: the in-tray at the board's desk

plate.why: the body's own name, on its nameplate

letter.en: TO: THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
letter.why: the ITU's own form of address for a member state; the letters are the board's

stamps.why: the board's three verbs, as stamps; not quotations

register.why: the register card by the pile; the stamp is the station's reading of the record

post.en: Finnish aviation sees GPS interference around the clock (Traficom). Finland and the Baltics took it to the UN's ITU, whose board urged Russia to stop, again urged, then strongly urged. No reply on record. Finland and Lithuania trace it to Russia, which denies it. #GPS #Finland
post.fi: Traficomin mukaan ilmailu kohtaa Suomessa GPS-häiriöitä ympäri vuorokauden. Suomi ja Baltian maat veivät asian YK:n alaiseen ITU:hun. Sen lautakunta kehotti Venäjää lopettamaan, kehotti uudelleen ja sitten painokkaasti. Vastausta ei ole kirjattu. Suomi ja Liettua jäljittävät häirinnän Venäjälle, joka kiistää sen.
post.ja: Traficomによると、フィンランドの航空ではGPS妨害が24時間続いている。フィンランドとバルト三国は国連のITUに訴えた。その委員会はロシアに停止を求め、再び求め、さらに強く求めた。記録された返答はない。フィンランドとリトアニアは妨害の発信源をロシアとしているが、ロシアは否定している。
